using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
long long dp[105][25][11];
char A[105];
int len;

long long go(int i, int pv, int v) {
    if (i == len) {
        return pv == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (dp[i][pv][v] != -1) {
        return dp[i][pv][v];
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    if (A[i] == '_') {
        for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
            if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
            int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
            ans = (ans + go(i + 1, y, v)) % MOD;
        }
    } else if (A[i] == 'X') {
        if (v != 10) {
            ans = (ans + go(i + 1, (pv * 10 + v) % 25, v)) % MOD;
        } else {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
                ans = (ans + go(i + 1, y, j)) % MOD;
            }
        }
    } else {
        ans = (ans + go(i + 1, (pv * 10 + (A[i] - '0')) % 25, v)) % MOD;
    }
    return dp[i][pv][v] = ans;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    string input;
    cin >> input;
    strcpy(A, input.c_str());
    len = strlen(A);
    
    if (len == 1 && A[0] == '0') {
        cout << "1" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (A[0] == '0') {
        cout << "0" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (len == 1) {
        if (A[0] == 'X' || A[0] == '_') {
            cout << "1" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof(dp));
    cout << go(0, 0, 10) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
